headline: Sensex and Nifty Rally Over 500 Points as Crude Oil Prices Ease

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Easing crude oil prices provided a significant boost to Indian market sentiment
The market experienced a strong rebound after six consecutive weekly falls
Positive global cues as US stock futures climbed following a rally in AI shares
Market resilience and buying interest despite ongoing tensions in West Asia
whatHappening: The Sensex jumped 564 points to end the session above the 23,400 mark
Core industries growth slowed to 4.8% in August due to iron ore and coal drag
NHAI issued new guidelines for access-controlled high-speed highways in India
India and Canada are scheduled to hold trade pact talks starting October 5
summary: The Indian stock market ended higher on September 21, with the Sensex jumping 564 points to close above 23,400. The rally was driven by falling crude oil prices and a recovery after six weeks of losses, despite core industry growth slowing to 4.8% in August. Tata Steel is seeking discussions with the UK government regarding its delayed electric arc furnace project.
